item.title: Animation Principles
item.description: Learn the twelve principles of animation and how to apply them to create believable movement in 3D animation. Master the fundamental principles of animation that bring characters and objects to life through believable movement and performance.

item.title: Lessons
item.description: Lessons group lectures, tutorials and exercises around a set of learning objectives.

item.title: Animating a bouncing ball
item.description: In this exercise, level 1 students will practice keyframe animation to animate a bouncing ball Learning Objectives Practice keyframe animation of translation, rotation, and scale properties. Become familiarized with keyframe animation. Apply principles of animation Instructions Watch linked tutorials in Learning Resources to get acquainted with animation tools. item.title: Animated textures
item.description: In this exercise, you will apply an image sequence as texture object in Blender, render a final Blender animation as an image sequence, and import it into after effects. You will create a compressed video in a web streaming format called H.264. Learning Objectives Become familiarized with adding animation sequences as moving textures on 3D geometry. item.title: Pathways
item.description: A pathway is one run of a course, 6 or 15 weeks, shaped around what you want to do in 3D. Everyone starts with CGI Foundations; after that, choose a pathway, and take it again at a higher level on a repeat run.

item.title: You don't see that everyday objects
item.description: For this project, you will produce 3D rendered images of products and other objects you experience every day, but with one slight difference. You will augment the object in such a way to inhibit its utility, material qualities, or its system or environmental context. <br><br> To explore these concepts, we delve into the philosophical realm of objects and their existence, considering how we interact with them in both a functional and perceptual sense. item.title: CGI Foundations
item.description: CGI Foundations is where every DART pathway starts. You will learn how 3D images are made, from polygons to pixels, and practice each stage of the pipeline twice: once on an airline chair and once on a room. The pathway ends with a project that brings modeling, texturing, lighting and rendering together in work of your own. After Foundations Foundations is the prerequisite for every other pathway.
